read_replica_semantic_scene: read a Replica Semantic dataset folder and return a SceneInfo object with cameras and point cloud
compute_replica_intrinsics: compute the pinhole camera intrinsics for a Replica Semantic dataset given image height and width
load_replica_poses: load camera poses from a trajectory file and build Camera objects for each RGB image
split_train_valid_cameras: split Replica Semantic cameras into train and validation sets using every fourth image for validation
review_readReplicaSemanticInfo: review the readReplicaSemanticInfo function to understand how it loads point clouds, poses, and intrinsics
